productImport.title: Import Products
productImport.guideBody: Already have your products in another system? Upload your existing product data and import it instead of creating products manually.
productImport.noProductList: I don't have a product list
productImport.uploadHint: Upload Excel files (.xlsx) containing your products.
productImport.mappingHint: How are these fields named in your file? For barcodes, put multiple codes in one cell separated by semicolons (e.g. 123;456;789). Currency symbols in price cells (e.g. $12.50) are OK; the wizard currency is still used for the catalog.
productImport.selectFieldsHint: Choose which columns to import. Name and selling price are always included.
productImport.masterReviewHint: Review units, categories, and suppliers from your file. Match existing records or create new ones.
productImport.masterPrepareFailed: Could not prepare master data from the file.
productImport.masterConfirmFailed: Could not save master data for this import.
productImport.uploadPrerequisites: Please add the warehouse and currency first. You will need both before you can start importing products.
productImport.uploadHeadersNote: Make sure all column headers are in the first row of the Excel file. Do not leave empty rows above the headers.
productImport.uploadBarcodesNote: Make sure that barcodes are not duplicated. Each barcode should belong to only one product.
productImport.uploadFeesNote: Make sure the fees cells contain valid numbers and do not include unusual or unsupported characters.
productImport.uploadMultipleBarcodesNote: If a product has multiple barcodes, enter all barcodes in the same barcode cell and separate them with a semicolon (;).
productImport.uploadCurrencyNote: Currency symbols are accepted in the fees cells, such as $, ¢, €, and ل.س.
productImport.uploadSellingPriceNote: The selling price is required for every product.
productImport.existingProducts: We found {{count}} products in your account. Delete them from the Products page before running the initial import.
productImport.previewDescription: Review detected products and fix any issues before continuing.
productImport.previewErrorsDescription: Review these errors and fix them in the Excel file before continuing.
productImport.noPreviewErrorsDescription: No errors found in the imported data.
productImport.previewDataDescription: Preview of products that will be imported.
productImport.parseFailed: Could not read the uploaded files.
productImport.previewFailed: Could not build the import preview.

priceUpdate.title: Edit catalog prices from the invoice
priceUpdate.description: While creating a selling or buying invoice, click the pen icon next to a line price to change that product’s saved catalog price — not only the amount on the current invoice.

imageDescriptions.img0: After you confirm, the new price is stored on the product itself. Later invoices and the Products page will use the updated catalog price automatically.

dashboard.title: New Dashboard page
dashboard.description: A Dashboard entry is now available under Pages and on the Welcome page cards. You can already open the shell; charts and KPI cards will turn on gradually as each metric is finished.

imageDescriptions.img0: The main Dashboard view brings sales, profit, inventory, and activity into one place so you can monitor the business without jumping between pages.
imageDescriptions.img1: Find Dashboard in the Pages menu or open it from the Welcome page cards whenever you want a quick overview.
imageDescriptions.img2: Each KPI card starts as “coming soon” and becomes live once its backend metric is ready — no separate release needed for the page itself.

multipleBarcodes.title: Multiple barcodes per product
multipleBarcodes.description: One product can keep a primary barcode plus extra barcodes. Scanning any of them in invoice search or product lookup still opens the same item — useful when a supplier ships the same goods under different codes.

imageDescriptions.img0: Add or edit additional barcodes on the product form. They are checked for collisions across the tenant, so two products cannot share the same code.

productImport.title: Improved Excel product import
productImport.description: Import is more stable end to end: map Excel columns, review units/categories/suppliers before commit, then load products in batches with clearer error feedback.

imageDescriptions.img0: Start from Products → Import. Choose currency and fields, upload an .xlsx/.xlsm file, then map each selected field to its Excel column.
imageDescriptions.img1: In the master-data step you can match or create units, categories, and suppliers from the file values, then preview rows before the batched commit writes Products and stock.

cashBoxes.title: Live cash cards on the Dashboard
cashBoxes.description: We keep extending the Dashboard with new live cards. Cash boxes are now available so you can check balances, amounts, and related fees without leaving the overview.

imageDescriptions.img0: On the Dashboard you see four cash tiles: Daily Cash, Cash Reserve (safe), Online, and Total — so drawer cash, reserve, card/online money, and the combined balance stay visible together.
imageDescriptions.img1: On invoices, Daily Cash and Online appear for the payment path in use, so you can confirm which box the paid amount will land in (or leave from) before you save.

onlinePayment.title: Online payment on invoices
onlinePayment.description: When you create a selling or buying invoice you can choose Online as the payment method. Card and online payments post to the Online cash account automatically — no separate cash-box picker.

imageDescriptions.img0: Select Online on the invoice payment controls. The paid amount updates the Online balance for the active warehouse; cash payments still go to Daily Cash as before.

cashTransfer.title: Transfer between cash boxes
cashTransfer.description: Move money between Daily Cash, Cash Reserve, and Online when you need to top up the drawer, park cash in the safe, or settle online proceeds — without booking it as income or expense.

imageDescriptions.img0: Use Quick Entry → Transfer (online required). Pick the from and to boxes, enter the amount, and optionally a reason. The system posts both legs so balances stay in sync across Daily, Reserve, and Online.

cashHistory.title: Cash movement history from Dashboard cards
cashHistory.description: Click a cash card on the Dashboard (Daily Cash, Cash Reserve, Online, or Total) to open that box’s ledger and review every movement — invoices, receipts, payments, expenses, and transfers.

imageDescriptions.img0: The history list shows each posting with amount, direction, and linked activity so you can audit how the balance changed over time for the selected cash box.

warehouseInvoice.title: Wholesale and half-wholesale invoices
warehouseInvoice.description: You can now create wholesale and half-wholesale invoices easily. Choose the invoice type, add products, and prices are applied according to that type.

imageDescriptions.img0: Create a wholesale or half-wholesale invoice from the arrow next to New Invoice → Wholesale / Half-wholesale.
